preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of roads m must be non-negative and less than the number of cities n.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: All cities in the roads must be valid city indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n for xi in queries)
preconditions.description: All city indices in the queries must be valid.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the longest path in the region containing city xi.

postconditions.expression: any(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in merge_queries)
postconditions.description: For merge queries, the cities must be valid and the regions must be merged correctly.

invariants.description: The number of roads must remain consistent with the input.
The number of queries must remain consistent with the input.
